keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Sekou Kone (New York Red Bulls).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (New York Red Bulls).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! New York Red Bulls 1, Atlanta United 0. Adri Mehmeti (New York Red Bulls) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the high centre of the goal.
Delay in match because of an injury Paulo Díaz (Atlanta United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Goal! New York Red Bulls 2, Atlanta United 0. Cade Cowell (New York Red Bulls) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Sekou Kone with a through ball.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Substitution, Atlanta United. Cooper Sanchez replaces Tristan Muyumba.
Giuliano Galoppo (Atlanta United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, New York Red Bulls. Rafael Mosquera replaces Cade Cowell.
Substitution, New York Red Bulls. Mijahir Jiménez replaces Jorge Ruvalcaba.
Julián Bazán (New York Red Bulls) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Atlanta United. Matt Edwards replaces Elías Báez.
Substitution, Atlanta United. Jay Fortune replaces Giuliano Galoppo.
Goal! New York Red Bulls 3, Atlanta United 0. Jahkeele Marshall-Rutty (New York Red Bulls) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the top right corner.
Substitution, New York Red Bulls. Matthew Dos Santos replaces Devin Padelford.
Substitution, New York Red Bulls. Emil Forsberg replaces Adri Mehmeti.
Substitution, Atlanta United. Sérgio Santos replaces Breel Embolo.
Substitution, Atlanta United. Luke Brennan replaces Miguel Almirón.
Substitution, New York Red Bulls. Tim Parker replaces Sekou Kone.
